title: The 'Never Continue' Invariant & Autonomous Self-Healing Loops
summary: Agents must execute autonomously until tests are green without requiring human 'continue' prompts. Halting indicates a harness defect in context or exit criteria.

title: Cache-First Context Engineering
summary: Prompt prefix stability determines prompt caching rates. Static instructions and tool schemas must stay immutable.

title: Hermetic Sandboxing & Ephemeral Execution Boundaries
summary: Agent capability is bounded by environment determinism. Sandboxed execution with copy-on-write filesystems prevents drift and isolates credentials.

title: The AGENTS.md Invariant & Cloud Agent Asynchrony
summary: Keep AGENTS.md lean (<350 lines) for orientation and soft conventions. Cloud agents resolve issues asynchronously via Linear MCP and local pre-flight checks.

title: Guides-and-Sensors Discipline & Load-Bearing ADR Preservation
summary: Combat semantic drift using Guides (docs) and Sensors (linters/tests). ADRs with @load-bearing tags block agents from refactoring away critical edge cases.

title: Planner / Generator / Evaluator Splits
summary: Decoupled evaluator agents outperform self-evaluation by eliminating positive confirmation bias.

title: Subagent Context Isolation & MCP Dynamic Tool Namespacing
summary: Fan out read-only subagents for exploration to preserve orchestrator context. Standardize tools using Model Context Protocol (MCP) schemas.

title: Local Pre-Flight Harness Shield
summary: Shield remote CI/CD by enforcing local verification daemons before code changes push to remotes.

title: Sprint Contracts, GAN-Style Evaluator Gates, & Boundary Guardians
summary: Sprint Contracts establish upfront DoD bounds and visual proofs. Decoupled reviewer agents and Zod boundary parsing eliminate self-evaluation bias.

title: The Harness Invariant (Agent = Model + Harness)
summary: The model is a rented constant; the harness is the proprietary asset. Fix mistakes in the harness, not in longer prompts.
